slot.brief: Which of the given ions is colourless in aqueous solution (d0 or d10 ion like Cu+/Zn2+/Sc3+); single-concept recall.

stem: Which of the following ions is colourless in aqueous solution?

verdicts.working: Sc³⁺ has a d⁰ configuration, so it has no d–d transitions and is colourless. The other ions have partially filled d orbitals.

working:
$\text{Sc}^{3+}: [\text{Ar}]$ ($d^0$)\nNo $d$–$d$ transition is possible; the ion is colourless.

Independent check: Sc³⁺ has a d⁰ configuration, so it has no d–d transitions and is colourless. The other ions have partially filled d orbitals.
solution: Scandium(III) has the configuration $\text{Sc}^{3+}:[\text{Ar}]3d^0$. With no $d$ electrons, $d$–$d$ transitions are not possible, so the ion is colourless in aqueous solution.
